inputs.name: openvox_version
inputs.description: openvox-agent release to install, from https://github.com/OpenVoxProject/openvox/releases. Change it with checksums.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the package for each platform, by "PLATFORM/VERSION/ARCH". Change these with openvox_version.

inputs.name: manifest_path
inputs.description: Manifest file, or directory of manifests, on the host to apply. Whatever can write here can run anything as root, so keep it writable by root alone. When null, the circuit only installs the agent.

inputs.name: module_path
inputs.description: Directories on the host to look for modules in, separated by colons. When null, OpenVox's own default, under /etc/puppetlabs/code.

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.description: systemd OnCalendar expression that applies on a timer, such as "hourly" or "*:0/30". When null, there is no timer.

inputs.name: apply_trigger
inputs.description: Any string, such as a manifest's hash or a Git commit. Changing it applies on the next conn3x apply, for when something the circuit can't see has changed.
